corrections.rationale: Owner explicitly approves all ten exact lineups, tiers and planning banner defaults in #165. Reuse Dr Aphra defence, mirror, Reva, Starkiller and Bo-Katan definitions. Six exact variants are required to enforce full membership without changing global cores. Retain the original generic SLKR entry and all other matchups; existing shared-required-unit logic enforces resource exclusivity.
